mythology: Venerated in the Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha tradition. Historical fabric and devotional narratives are distinguished in the reference notes.
pilgrimage_significance: The Goddess is worshipped here through natural flames. A figurative main idol is not the central sacred form.
historical_notes: Hillside complex with gilded dome and rock-fissure flames as the central manifestation. Nine flame identities are documented; they are not nine invented detached temples.
